ops.title: desk-launch.py incident writes the incident store record, so the store and cci agree on open incidents
ops.description: Root ruling #104185 (release-v3, Oct 20): on Oct 20 every incident fix lane launched through desk-launch.py, and none of today's three outages has a record in ~/.claude/long-running/incidents; the store holds 8 records at status open from Oct 8-15 that nothing closed. owner_facing's incident guards (no_plan_mode_in_an_open_incident, plain_words_in_owner_questions, root_only_routes_during_an_incident) read the store OR cci digest open_incidents, both bounded to 6 h, so cci is the only live signal today. desk-launch.py incident should create the store record (actions.Store().create) for the incident it launches, and close it on fix-live/not-ours/stand-down, so both sources agree.

ops.text: desk-launch.py incident <name> creates ~/.claude/long-running/incidents/<name>.json at status open
a fix-live, not-ours, or stand-down record for that incident moves the store record to recovered or closed
